subject: SOC 2 Type II follow-up — sampling for privileged SSO token/session traces
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@primemed.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — sample request: privileged SSO token/session traces

Soojin,

Thanks again for the call earlier. As part of our SOC 2 Type II follow-up, our auditors asked for targeted samples of SSO/token/session events for privileged and service accounts across the audit period (2026-09-01 through 2027-02-28). To keep this scoped:

- Deliverable (sample): five (5) unique admin-user sessions across at least three different admin roles, plus traces for three service accounts that perform automated actions.
- Required fields: timestamp (UTC), event_type (token_issue, session_start, session_end, token_refresh), user_id (hashed is acceptable), role, source_ip, mfa_indicator (true/false and method if available), idp_assertion_id or similar.
- Format: CSV preferred; header row required.
- Security: user identifiers may be hashed but we need a persistent mapping for the audit team (delivered under NDA).
- Evidence of MFA: auditors expect an explicit signal that MFA occurred at authentication time (e.g., mfa_step timestamp or assertion flag).

I attached a rough spec (sso_trace_spec.csv) showing the columns we expect.

Questions for you:
1) Can you confirm you can extract token/session events for the audit window?
2) Do you have the idp assertion ids retained in logs?
3) Can we get samples by 2027-04-01 and the full extract (if required) by 2027-04-07?

If anything is out of scope for Redwood's standard retention, please flag now so we can document a bridge letter.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Senior IT Audit Manager
PrimeMed Health
elaine.park@primemed.com

Attachment: sso_trace_spec.csv (columns template)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@primemed.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 17:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — sample request: privileged SSO token/session traces

Hi Elaine,

Appreciate the clear spec. Confirming receipt — we can produce the CSV-style samples you describe for the audit window. Quick notes and constraints so expectations are aligned:

- Retention: Our primary auth/session telemetry is retained for 18 months by default. The requested window (2026-09-01 to 2027-02-28) falls within that retention, so we can pull logs. If we need longer historic traces later, we can provide a bridge letter explaining the retention policy.
- IDP assertions: We retain assertion identifiers for SAML/OIDC exchanges in our auth proxy logs. We can include the idp_assertion_id column, though some older service account flows may only have a token serial and not a full assertion id.
- Hashing: We will provide hashed pseudo_user_ids for samples. Map files (mapping back to actual usernames) will be produced securely under NDA if auditors require them.
- Scope clarification: do you want full session body (every event) or only token issuance and session start/end events? Full session bodies can be quite large; a trimmed extraction (as you outlined) is faster and usually sufficient.

Plan: Olga will run the extraction and produce the sample CSVs (attached delivery_plan.xlsx outlines steps and ETA). Laura will prepare a draft bridge letter if we need one. We aim to have the five admin-user samples and three service-account traces to you by EOD 2027-04-01. If that schedule is tight for you, let us know.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Security Partnerships (SaaS & Compliance)
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Attachment: delivery_plan.xlsx

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@primemed.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — sample request: privileged SSO token/session traces

On Mon, 29 Mar 2027 at 17:08 Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> - Scope clarification: do you want full session body (every event) or only token issuance and session start/end events?

Thanks — token issuance + session start/end + explicit MFA step indicators will be sufficient. If you can include token_refresh events for long-lived tokens, that helps too.

A couple of follow-ups:
- Hashed identifiers are fine. We will request the mapping only if the auditors need to prove identity during the fieldwork; please make that mapping available but under a separate secure transfer.
- If any of the requested fields are not retained for the whole window (e.g., idp_assertion_id for older service account flows), we will document through a bridge letter as you suggested. Please include language stating the retention window and any gaps.
- Example CSV header we expect: hashed_user_id, role, event_type, timestamp_utc, source_ip, mfa_method, idp_assertion_id, token_id

Deadlines: sample CSV rows by 2027-04-01; full extract (if auditors ask) by 2027-04-07.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — let me know if you hit any blockers.

Elaine

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@primemed.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — sample request: privileged SSO token/session traces

Hi Elaine,

Thanks — quick update from our side. Olga ran the extraction earlier today and we are packaging the samples as discussed. Deliverables you will receive (secure link/transfer):

1) sample_sso_traces_20270329.csv — five admin-user sessions + three service-account traces (CSV, header as requested). Identifiers are hashed (sha256).
2) mapping_instructions.txt — describes the secure process we will use to share the mapping if auditors request it under NDA.
3) bridge_letter_draft.pdf — draft bridge language that documents the 18-month retention policy and notes two older service-account flows where idp_assertion_id is not available (we included token_id there).

CSV field set: hashed_pseudo_user_id, role, event_type, timestamp_utc, source_ip, mfa_method, idp_assertion_id, token_id

We will sign the bridge letter with our Compliance lead if auditors require it. Full extracts (if requested) can be scheduled for delivery by 2027-04-07; please confirm if you need the full set.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: bridge_letter_draft.pdf
